title: Partial-Refund Credit in Northgate Marketplace Unrefunded-Return Claims
content:
Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee — basis questions on seller partial refunds.

**Rule.** The partial-refund credit taken from the amount claimed for an unrefunded return follows the seller's partial refunds recorded on that line: where the line carries partial refunds and the units of the requested line kept are more than zero, the credit is those partial refunds times the requested units divided by the units bought on the line; where the line carries partial refunds and no unit remains among the units of the requested line kept, the credit is the whole of those partial refunds; otherwise there is no credit.

**Which entries count?** Only the seller's partial refunds recorded on the same line; partial refunds on other lines of the order, and refunds of other kinds, are not these partial refunds.

**What decides between a share and the whole?** Whether the units of the requested line kept are more than zero. More than zero gives a share, those partial refunds times the requested units divided by the units bought on the line; exactly zero gives the whole of the partial refunds.

**Hypothetical figures.** A line of 3 units bought carries partial refunds of USD 30.00 and 1 unit is in the requested units. Where the units of the requested line kept are 1 or more, the credit is 30.00 times 1 divided by 3, that is 10.00; where none remains, the credit is the whole 30.00; a line with no partial refund gives no credit.
